questions.question: When soldiers led Jesus away to be crucified, what did they make Simon of Cyrene carry behind Him?
While Jesus hung on the cross, what did He ask His Father about the people crucifying Him?

answers.text: Forgive them because they don't know what they're doing
Judge them for everything they have done to Me
Take Me down from this cross before the night

questions.question: When a dying criminal asked Jesus to remember him, where did Jesus say he would be with Him that day?
After Jesus died on the cross, the Roman centurion said Jesus was surely what kind of man?
